scope_note: 31 complete file reads, 2670 lines. Source review only in this continuation; no suite, live application or manual TUI execution. Remaining 44 manifest files are unreviewed in this unit.
preserve: Membership checkpoint tests recompute the checksum after adding a forbidden content field, so rejection cannot pass merely on checksum mismatch. Marker tests enforce content-free reasons, extra-field rejection, private file mode and corrupt-content rejection.

Publication log tests separate daemon-owned outcome location from workspace symlinks and preserve the target of a rejected configured symlink. Fs tests exercise fresh BEAM quarantine names with both archived byte sequences; fsync:true content equality alone does not prove crash durability.

JSONSafe asserts the complete normalized identity record. OpaqueIdentifier bounds size/type/format and rejects credential shapes. SecretRedactor covers multiple credentials, idempotence and escaped capability URLs; these fixtures do not establish exhaustive secret detection.

Shell tests round-trip quoting edge cases through a real POSIX shell, including newlines and expansion syntax. SupervisorToken explicitly treats whitespace-only values as absent while rejecting surrounding whitespace on nonempty credentials.

CPU tests preserve unavailable versus valid headroom and reclaimable nice time; descriptor tests distinguish exhausted EMFILE from ordinary unavailable samples and assert exact injected usage/limit arithmetic. Host procfs coverage is conditional on platform.

LauncherWatchdog tests inject liveness and verify callback plus normal process termination, not actual host restart. Claude backend tests retain workspace refusal and closed-port tolerance; they do not launch a provider.

IssueContext tests preserve truncate-before-wrap ordering, escaped delimiter balance, author attribution and secret/hidden-content removal. AgentEventLog retains non-alert events, tuple crash reasons and markdown/NDJSON output, with explicit remote no-op and best-effort write failure semantics.

DecisionDispatch tests assert correlation identity and lifecycle guidance with injected send callbacks. DecisionProvenance restamps trusted acceptance time, preserves unknown model facts and refuses content-bearing/credential identity fields. DecisionArtifact distinguishes canonical local paths from HTTPS host-policy and encoded-credential refusal.

PollCadence preserves explicit zero freshness tolerance, last valid cadence and bounded widening. Meter events distinguish generation-scoped and fan-out topics; private store/projection integration checks actual observed values and removal of generation identity, not rendered dashboard UX.

Usage CLI tests inject a private projection, synchronize observation via a server round-trip, assert ages and unknown states, and distinguish credits/local concurrency from provider percentages. Webhook mode fixtures require observed activity to classify silence as degraded.

AffectedTests covers fail-closed executable/build changes and missing mappings, deleted-reference boundaries and dependency mappings; configured .aiur paths are deliberately excluded. ModelCatalog fixtures retain provider order, hidden-model exclusion and unknown-shape errors rather than empty success.

TrackedSet tests freeze poll mutation before restarting the application-owned controller and assert ETS ownership survives. SaturationSentinel covers pure escalation/cooldown decisions and diagnostic append behavior; its mutable global configuration remains a test-isolation follow-up.

cross_references.finding: Explicitly terminates the application-owned PubSub child and tests its recovery. Relate this to tests-2-01 shared-supervisor coupling, but do not infer terminate_child causes the same automatic rest_for_one cascade as an unexpected child crash.
Controller restart uses the application supervisor after freezing polls; this is another package-boundary integration seam, not an independent demonstrated flake.

follow_up_candidates.question: This async module writes global :aiur/:log_file for file_path and restores nil via put_env rather than deleting an absent key. Check concurrent readers and test-support isolation before promoting a cross-test contamination finding.

Unlinked watcher cleanup occurs only after two assertions; an early assertion failure may leave its infinite sleeper alive. Check suite lifecycle and demonstrate the failure path before promoting a leak finding; successful-path cleanup exists.
